series.title: Masculine Psychology

key_quotes.text: Without modulated, tuned, trained aggression, you will not be able to organise.
key_quotes.context: Moore on why aggression must be developed rather than suppressed

key_quotes.text: Anger will seek the right. It'll seek to correct things. And not destroy everything.
key_quotes.context: Distinguishing anger from rage, which he calls unregulated warrior energy

key_quotes.text: Nice is not a term we apply to men. That is a term we apply to boys.
key_quotes.context: The price of nice, from George Bach's Creative Aggression

king-archetype.description: The mature masculine energy of ordering, blessing, and generativity

warrior-archetype.description: The mature masculine energy of discipline, courage, and action

magician-archetype.description: The mature masculine energy of awareness, wisdom, and transformation

lover-archetype.description: The mature masculine energy of connection, passion, and appreciation

shadow-work.description: Process of integrating unconscious and repressed archetypal energies

initiation.description: Masculine rites of passage and developmental transitions

archetypal-possession.description: When archetypal energies overwhelm the ego

masculine-maturity.description: Development from boy psychology to mature masculine

ordering.definition: The King's capacity to bring structure, stability, and right relationship to chaos

blessing.definition: The King's power to affirm, empower, and call forth potential in others

generativity.definition: The creative, life-giving capacity to nurture and bring forth growth

discipline.definition: The Warrior's capacity for focused commitment and consistent action

boundaries.definition: The Warrior's ability to define, defend, and maintain appropriate limits

awareness.definition: The Magician's capacity for clear perception and conscious knowing

transformation.definition: The Magician's power to transmute one form of energy into another

connection.definition: The Lover's capacity for authentic relationship and felt experience

passion.definition: The Lover's full engagement with life, purpose, and meaning
